desc: Intact light-gray vinyl siding wall beside a white-trimmed Florida window, with matching siding profile samples and a plain zip tool staged on a clean folded cloth for comparison.
reuse_notes: Use for vinyl siding panel matching, profile comparison, siding-material selection, exterior-envelope repair preparation, and storm-repair articles. It depicts a generic material-matching scene, never a JK Prestige project or a substitute for manufacturer-specific panel, fastening, and weather-resistive-barrier requirements.
